title: Hidden Potential
author: Adam Grant
engineRationale: Grant's persuasive engine is the everyman reader who believes they lack innate talent, not any single nameable figure; the book's cases (chess, Finnish schools, the Golden Thirteen, knuckleballer R.A. Dickey) are illustrations of an abstract thesis about character skills and scaffolding. Emotional subject = the ordinary striver, which is exactly Antidote's flat-vector everyman + kinetic typography lane. Letting Antidote win per steering (it has never shipped a real book).
